status: Named SVG icon asset sets bound to kinds. Four production libraries (network-generic@1, vsm-symbols@1, pid-common@1, electrical-common@1) plus the generic demo set. All artwork is common-practice agent-drawn rendering — standards compliance pending document review. Vendor packs (Cisco/AWS/Azure/GCP) excluded pending licensing diligence.
